# Hybrid Search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion

Provides a unified search interface that combines keyword (full-text search) and semantic (vector-based KNN) search results using reciprocal-rank fusion. Enables robust retrieval by blending results from both strategies depending on the availability of current semantic embeddings.
